name: Red Fire telephone EVC outstation
subtitle: C/w handset; push to open version
legacyName: Red Fire telephone EVC outstation c/w handset (push to open version)
summary: The EVC301PRO is an attractive Type A fire telephone outstation c/w telephone-style handset for use with the Sigtel Fire Telephone system of Context Plus.
description: Supplied in a durable ‘push-to-open’ red steel case.
Ideal for use in fire telephone systems.
Allows stewards and fire marshals to communicate with a SigTEL Master Controller (and vice versa).
Facilitates reliable two-way communication in a fire emergency between a permanently manned control room and key points of a site.
Can be surface mounted using a T-BEZ302 bezel.
Meets and exceeds the requirements of BS 5839-9 when correctly installed.

specs.label: Approvals/certifications
specs.value: Facilitates compliance with BS5839-9 when correctly installed.

specs.label: Supply/operating voltage
specs.value: 11V DC derived from a compatible SigTEL Master Controller (drops to 6 V DC when in use).

specs.label: Activation current
specs.value: 25mA (current draw when handset is in use).

specs.label: Indicators
specs.value: When the operator in the control room calls the outstation, a pulsed ringing tone sounds at the outstation.

specs.label: Controls
specs.value: 'Push to Open' catch. Telephone-style handset (lift to answer or make a call).

specs.label: Product dimensions (mm)
specs.value: 202 W x 278 H x 100 D mm.

specs.label: Notes
specs.value: Microphone frequency response 250 Hz to 5 kHz ±3 dB; Loudspeaker frequency response 250 Hz to 4 kHz ±3 dB.
